title: Acorn to Oak Wine Experience
specs: Supports Linfield University Wine Studies Program and scholarships
Must be 21 years or older to order or receive alcoholic beverages
Receipt of shipments requires signature of sober adult 21 or older
Hosts groups up to 6 for traditional wine experiences; larger parties can book private events in back room lounge
Welcomes well-behaved dogs and families with children
includes: Access to private tour of Oregon Wine Archives
Invitations to three catered wine tasting receptions each year
Special offers at all partnering wineries
Complimentary tastings for club members (2 guests for Acorn Tier, 4 guests for Oak Tier)
Discounts on all purchases (15% for Acorn Tier, 20% for Oak Tier)
gap: Price for wine club memberships not fully stated
blurb: Guests taste wines from 29 Oregon producers in a cozy tasting room in downtown McMinnville. The experience includes curated tasting flights, wine by the glass, or bottle service. The business also offers wine club memberships with customizable allocations and member benefits.
extraNote: Orders by credit card only (Visa, MasterCard, American Express) · No minimum purchase required · Shipping restricted in certain US states · Wine shipping subject to weather conditions; no replacement for damage due to extreme weather if customer requests shipment during weather hold · Tasting Room at 546 NE 3rd St., McMinnville, OR
